text:
Predicates:
Appropriate(x) ::: x is appropriate for people of all ages.
CanWatchWithoutGuidance(x) ::: children can watch film x without guidance from parents.
ContainsExcessiveContent(x) ::: film x contains excessive erotic and violent content.
RatedGeneralAudience(x) ::: film x is rated General Audience.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) ::: film x is a family-friendly animated film.
MovieInFrozenSeries(x) ::: film x is in the Frozen series.
Film(x) ::: x is a film.
Hachi ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale'.

Premises:
∀x (Appropriate(x) → CanWatchWithoutGuidance(x)) ::: If a film is appropriate for people of all ages, then children can watch it without guidance from parents.
∀x (ContainsExcessiveContent(x) → ¬CanWatchWithoutGuidance(x)) ::: If a film contains excessive erotic and violent content, children cannot watch it without guidance from their parents.
∀x (RatedGeneralAudience(x) → Appropriate(x)) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, then it is appropriate for people of all ages.
∀x (FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) → RatedGeneralAudience(x)) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
∀x (MovieInFrozenSeries(x) → FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x)) ::: All movies in the Frozen series are family-friendly animated films.
Film(Hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is a film.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(Hachi) ⊕ Appropriate(Hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either a family-friendly animated film or is appropriate for people of all ages.

Conclusion:
ContainsExcessiveContent(Hachi) ∨ MovieInFrozenSeries(Hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' contains excessive erotic and violent content or is in the 'Frozen' series or both.
